lines.text: How has the knee been since last time, pain out of ten?
Since last time it has been sitting at four out of ten.
Make that a six, it flared up on the stairs yesterday.
Okay. Any swelling since last time?
Since last time there has been a little swelling at the end of the day.
Yeah, it was actually worse on Sunday after the barbecue.
I'll do some massage around the quads and send you some exercises.
